news.scope: Dated publisher-linked science/nature material fetched by the deployed service with evidence and alignment gates. Source coverage is limited, not full-web news. Transport/source-gate success is not a guarantee that every generated claim or opening is ideal; some openings can still be technical or depend too much on a referenced picture.

fixedThisContinuation: Test locator aligned with existing 开启麦克风 accessible label, without weakening product assertions
Preserve explicitly specified time windows rather than narrowing 午前 to 朝 for simplicity
Separate known-intent help from illustrative/open-starter help; unknown answers are labelled examples instead of being suppressed or certified as personal facts
Eight new pure helper-contract tests cover example labels, context contradiction, malformed flags and faithful intent
limits: Human iPhone microphone, accent, real pauses and interruption comfort remain unverified
Some ordinary responses are still longer or more interrogative than ideal; semantic quality varies
Adaptation remains a conservative heuristic, not a JLPT/fluency score or proven learning improvement
News sources and topic quality remain limited; no claim of universal factual correctness or always-fresh availability
API usage remains billable and bounded; provider data retention is separate from app non-persistence
